description: The chart illustrates model performance across several repetition-related evaluation metrics, showing four bars per metric corresponding to decoding strategy and model size. The horizontal axis contains the metric categories labeled “EGP ↑”, “TR-N ↓”, a third metric label that is partially obscured but shows a downward arrow (↓), and “CCP ↑”, arranged left to right in that order; the axis label is “Metrics.” The vertical axis is labeled “Performance” and uses a linear scale from 0.0 to 1.0 with evenly spaced tick marks at approximately 0.2 intervals. For each metric group, there are four adjacent bars identified by the legend: Greedy (CodeLlama-7B) in blue, RPG (CodeLlama-7B) in orange, Greedy (CodeLlama-34B) in green, and RPG (CodeLlama-34B) in dark orange. For “EGP ↑”, the blue bar is near 0.01, the orange bar is about 0.89, the green bar is about 0.59, and the dark-orange bar is about 0.99. For “TR-N ↓”, the blue bar is about 0.70, the orange bar about 0.46, the green bar about 0.62, and the dark-orange bar about 0.40. For the third (partially obscured) “↓” metric, the blue bar is about 0.68, the orange bar about 0.42, the green bar about 0.45, and the dark-orange bar about 0.31. For “CCP ↑”, the blue bar is about 0.40, the orange bar about 0.72, the green bar about 0.70, and the dark-orange bar about 0.94. The bars are grouped by metric with consistent color ordering within each group, there is no indication that categories are sorted by value, and no individual bars appear specially emphasized beyond the legend and standard coloring.
